neighbours.label: the end of a concessive 'While ...' or 'Although ...' clause (While ubiquitous,; While X plays a critical role,; Although much of ...), as opposed to a temporal 'while' and plain sentences
fire: While common, these pots are also very useful.
While the game captures much of the era's charm, it feels new.
While this rule affects everyone, it hurts small firms most.
Although much of the region is dry, the valley is green.
While the gene clearly plays a key role, others matter too.
Although most people agree, a few object.
While expensive, the course is worth it.
Although he was tired, he stayed.
quiet: While I was eating, the doorbell rang.
While we waited for the bus, it rained.
These pots are also very useful.
Much of the region is dry.
The gene is on the short arm of the chromosome.
He was tired and he left.

notes: Temporal ' while' reached 0.02 in a probe.
